1.title: Jenny Hoyos Locks in on New Live & Community Features
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube Live product head and creator discuss new live features (go live together, live showdowns, watch with videos, Hype with Jewels) and community/membership integrations. First-hand account from platform leadership.

1.title: How did HubSpot lose 140M visits, and still keep growing? - Kieran Flanagan [HubSpot]
1.author: Guillaume Moubeche
1.hook: Kieran Flanagan (HubSpot SVP) on rebuilding GTM for AI: HubSpot lost 80% organic traffic (140M visits) in one year but kept growing through AI experiments (3–10x conversion lifts), creator networks (350 creators, 5x growth in some), optimizing for ChatGPT/Gemini, and shifting from SEO to answer-engine distribution. Also covers taste/judgment in AI systems and why half of HubSpot's revenue now comes from free-tier users.

2.title: I Tested Gemini 4 vs Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Astra vs Muse Wonder (5 Use Cases)
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: Comparative testing of four frontier LLMs (Gemini 4, Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Muse Wonder) across five concrete use cases — 3D modeling in Blender, game development in three.js, animated storytelling, website design, and writing — with specific prompts and model-by-model winners named.

3.title: Accent-uate, Don't Compensate: Why Clarity Matters More Than Perfection
3.author: Think Fast Talk Smart
3.hook: Communication coach and linguist Peter Novak discusses accent bias, prosody techniques, and vocal delivery strategies for non-native English speakers in professional settings.
